title: Cleaner live Night coverage
summary: Keeps Night focused on the current operational plan while Changes remains the place to explain and manage staffing changes.
changes: Renames the operational team section to Tonight’s coverage and keeps it focused on the current working plan.
Keeps absences, overtime and allocation explanations in Changes instead of duplicating them on Night.
Removes the old View full roster row from Night and routes Changes tonight directly to the Changes workflow.
Publishes the redesign as a new PWA release so installed iPhone apps receive a fresh cache namespace and asset URLs.
